title: 第18章 唐人不争气的一姐

第18章 唐人不争气的一姐-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》

走出办公室，老胡一眼就看见坐在休息区的刘施施。

这姑娘整个人蜷在沙发里，眉头紧锁，眼睛几乎要贴到手机屏幕上，灵活的手指在按键上疯狂点戳。

“施施，别玩手机了，你本来就近视。”

“啊？”

刘施施抬头，皱了皱好看的眉头：“老胡，我都21了，再怎么看视力都不会下降，这是有科学依据的。”

鬼扯科学依据，天天给你玩游戏找理由！！

面对这位唐人重点培养的师妹，胡哥实在没办法。

别看这姑娘长相秀丽温婉，骨子里却是个男孩子，皮得很。

他作为唐人老大哥每次想提点她几句，都被对方鬼扯糊弄过去。

久而久之，胡哥便放弃了劝人学好的想法。

施施这倒霉孩子，一般男人管不了。

来到面前，看了眼手机屏幕，胡哥挑了挑眉毛。

玩俄罗斯方块玩的这么激动？

“行了别玩了。K姐叫你过去。”

“好。”

把手机揣兜里，刘施施赶紧问：“老胡，K姐今天的心情怎么样？”

“放心吧，她今天不会骂你。”

“好嘞”

得到好消息，刘施施眉眼弯弯，她欢快的打开了蔡怡农的办公室。

“K姐，我来啦。”

她探头进门，见蔡怡农正对着电脑出神，便蹑手蹑脚绕到老板身后。

老蔡正在看电脑，上面播放的正是魏沐的唱歌视频。

这段视频她看了不下十次，每次看都觉得这小子真帅。

“哇，K姐，你原来喜欢这个类型啊？”

“怎么。你不喜欢？”

蔡艺侬转头笑着问。

她和施施关系不错，不是简单的上下关系。

自从去年把刘施施签进唐人影视，蔡怡农一直对她颇有照顾。

每次看到她这张脸，老蔡都能想到自己年轻的时候。

她从京城来到魔都生活，现在还住在自己的家里。

刘施施想了想，轻轻点头：“嗯...是挺招人喜欢的。”

谁不喜欢帅哥呢？

“那你可抓紧了，这小子刚分手。”

“啊？你怎么知道？”

老蔡没有说话，而是当着刘施施的面按下了重播键。

When Lao Hu walked out of the office, he saw Liu Shishi sitting in the rest area.

The girl was curled up on the sofa, her brows furrowed, her eyes almost pressed to the screen of her phone, and her nimble fingers poking at the buttons crazily.

"Shi Shi, stop playing with your phone. You are short-sighted to begin with."

"Huh?"

Liu Shishi raised his head and wrinkled his beautiful brows: "Old Hu, I'm 21, and my eyesight will not decline no matter how I look. This is based on scientific evidence."

This nonsense is based on scientific evidence and will give you reasons to play games every day!!

Facing this junior sister whom the Tang people focused on training, Brother Hu really had no choice.

Although this girl looks beautiful and gentle, she is actually a boy at heart, very naughty.

As the big brother of the Tang Dynasty, every time he wanted to mention her a few words, he was fooled by the other party's nonsense.

Over time, Brother Hu gave up the idea of ​​persuading people to learn good things.

Most men can't control Shi Shi, an unlucky child.

When he came to the front, he glanced at the phone screen and Brother Hu raised his eyebrows.

Are you so excited to play Tetris?

"Okay, stop playing. Sister K asked you to come over."

"Okay."

Putting the phone in his pocket, Liu Shishi quickly asked: "Lao Hu, how is Sister K's mood today?"

"Don't worry, she won't scold you today."

“Okay”

After receiving the good news, Liu Shishi's eyebrows curled up, and she happily opened Cai Yinong's office.

"Sister K, I'm here."

She poked her head in and saw Cai Yinong lost in thought at the computer, so she crept around behind her boss.

Lao Cai was looking at the computer, and what was playing on it was Wei Mu's singing video.

She has watched this video no less than ten times, and every time she watches it, she thinks this guy is really handsome.

"Wow, Sister K, do you like this type?"

"What. You don't like it?"

Cai Yinong turned around and asked with a smile.

She has a good relationship with Shi Shi, not a simple up-and-down relationship.

Since signing Liu Shishi to Tangren Film and Television last year, Cai Yinong has always taken good care of her.

Every time he sees her face, Lao Cai can think of himself when he was young.

She came to live in the Magic City from the capital and is still living in her own home.

Liu Shishi thought for a moment and nodded slightly: "Well...it's quite likable."

Who doesn't like handsome guys?

"Then hurry up, this guy just broke up with you."

"Ah? How do you know?"

Lao Cai did not speak, but pressed the replay button in front of Liu Shishi.
